Stipend to cover cost of living and other benefits

CIF Youth Fellowship 2025 is an opportunity offered by the Climate Investment Funds (CIF)* in partnership with Multilateral Development Bank (MDB)** to Indian candidates aged between 18-28 years. The fellowship provides young climate leaders with the opportunity to work with projects co-financed by the CIF in their country of residence. Selected candidates will receive a stipend to cover the cost of living in fellowship countries and other benefits for the duration of the fellowship.
is a unique professional capacity-building program focused on providing hands-on experience to the next generation of young leaders.
are international financial institutions that provide financial and technical assistance to developing countries.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be in the age group of 18-28 years during the time of application
hold an undergraduate or graduate degree in Engineering/Economics/Finance/Public Policy/Environmental Science or other related subjects
be fluent and have good writing skills in English and the native language
be proficient in basic computer programs
have strong analytical and conceptual skills and the ability to interpret and present technical/research information
be available for 16 hours (part-time)/40 hours (full-time) a week
Selected candidates will receive the following benefits -
Stipend covering the cost of living in India and other fellowship countries (Purchasing Power Parity).
In-kind logistical support such as staff time for mentoring and office space.
Specialized training and professional development sessions
Identity proof/age proof (Aadhaar card/Voter ID card/Passport etc.)

Question: What is the last date to apply for the CIF Youth Fellowship?
The last date to apply for the CIF Youth Fellowship is 18 December 2024.
Question: What is the age limit to apply for the CIF Youth Fellowship?
The applicants must belong to the age group of 18-28 years during the time of application.
Question: Who can apply for the CIF fellowship?
The students pursuing graduate degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance, Public Policy, Environmental Science or other related subjects.
Question: Can Indian students apply for this fellowship?
Yes, Indian nationals are eligible to apply for this fellowship.
Question: Who is offering this fellowship?
The Climate Investment Funds (CIF) in partnership with Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) is offering the fellowship.
